description: This Java source file defines the class LegacyCommandClientImpl, a client implementation for sending commands via the Eclipse Hono framework's legacy control endpoint using Vert.x and Proton APIs. It provides methods to create and send command messages, handle responses, and manage AMQP links. It also contains factory methods for creating instances scoped to specific tenants and devices.

classes.name: LegacyCommandClientImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a client for sending commands via Hono's legacy control endpoint, extending AbstractRequestResponseClient with BufferResult type, providing methods for command transmission, link management, and client creation.

methods.name: LegacyCommandClientImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with connection, tenant, device, reply ID, and optional AMQP links.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Static method to generate the target address for sending commands based on tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the endpoint name for this client, which is the legacy control endpoint.

methods.name: createMessageId
methods.description: Generates a short, incrementing message ID string for correlating requests and responses.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Creates a BufferResult instance encapsulating response status, content type, payload, and application properties.

methods.name: sendCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with optional content type and properties, returns a Future with BufferResult, tracks response and handles errors.

methods.name: sendOneWayCommand
methods.description: Sends a one-way command (without expecting a response), with optional content type and properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create a new client instance for a specific tenant and device with specified link close handlers.
